collector_bootstrap: Existing /usr/bin/python3 stdlib with -I -S; not proof of required Python tool closure; never installed by payload.

trust.owner_references: Template values are unbound. Per-original input is allowlisted as UNVERIFIED claims. An adopted external owner receiver must authenticate and verify source/payload/manifest and all actual job/profile/image/reset refs. Payload does not verify adoption.
trust.time: T0/E are same-original unverified claims with explicit clock origin/units. Collector UTC timestamps are separate. No cross-clock comparisons, budget renewal or cleanup inference.
trust.scope: Local namespace observations are not authenticated guest identity or host resource enforcement. Fixture data is synthetic; all acceptance cells NOT_RUN.

limits.outer_receiver: Retains whole stdout SHA/start/end/exit, actual original bounds, descendant custody and reset proof. Payload output cannot hash itself or prove reset.

read_only: fixed version-only tool commands; no owner-supplied executables
